key_insight: FlexPart brings different levels of user control into one image-to-3D part generation model. Users can guide generation with sparse points, bounding boxes, or masks rather than relying on separate models for each input type.
problem_solved: Existing 3D part generation methods lack the flexibility to support workflows that require different amounts and types of geometric guidance.
method: Introduce a unified framework for generating 3D parts from images with variable-granularity geometric conditions.
Accept heterogeneous guidance, including sparse points, bounding boxes, and masks.
Integrate these inputs through gated adaptive modulation within a single model.
impact: A unified model could simplify controllable 3D asset creation and let practitioners adapt guidance to available annotations or user preferences. The provided abstract is truncated, so performance gains and evaluation results cannot be assessed.

paper_title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
paper_authors: Qiwen Gu, Xin Zhou, Xiwu Chen, Zhongyang Zhu, Zhuo Zhang
